summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares RBS2418, described as an immune modulator, with placebo in adults with advanced, metastatic, progressive colorectal cancer. Participants take two 200 mg RBS2418 capsules by mouth twice a day, or matching placebo capsules, plus best supportive care; how long treatment lasts is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is listed as Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara RBS2418, descrito como un modulador inmunitario, con placebo en adultos con cáncer colorrectal avanzado, metastásico y progresivo. Los participantes toman dos cápsulas de 200 mg de RBS2418 por vía oral dos veces al día, o cápsulas de placebo iguales, además de cuidados de soporte; la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El resultado principal que mide el estudio no se indica en el registro; el estudio figura como fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with advanced, metastatic, progressive colorectal cancer.
Have received, been ineligible for, intolerant to, or declined all approved standard therapies for metastatic colorectal cancer.
Documented disease progression on two scans performed within 2 to 4 months of study start.
Colorectal cancer confirmed by pathology report.
Willing to provide a pre-treatment tissue sample.
not_for: Anti-cancer therapy, chemotherapy, targeted therapy, immunotherapy, or radiation within 2 weeks before the first dose.
Not recovered to grade 1 or baseline from side effects of a previous treatment.
Rapid progression on prior therapy with rapid clinical deterioration.
Other malignancies within 3 years before Day 1, with listed exceptions.
